scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Fixed-count affine Jacobi design, exact uncorrected centered sum of squares, independent equal-variance noise. Singular-endpoint coefficients and critical log factors newly distinguished from known moment exponents and continuous-density interior tube factors. Oracle slope-dependent tuning is not an implementable adaptive method; publication priority requires external verification.
title: Sharp Jacobi small-ball constants and oracle-ridge risk for noisy affine fitting
